verdict.rationale: Kong's own docs and repo describe plugins for enforcing rate limiting, including a dedicated Rate Limiting plugin, so the core capability ships as a first-party feature. The evidence pack never shows that limits can be scoped per consumer or per route, which is the specific shape this story asks for. missing for 10: documented per-consumer and per-route rate-limit scoping, configuration details of the Rate Limiting plugin, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce rate limits on API traffic per consumer or route

citations.quote: Plugins for enforcing traffic controls, rate limiting, req/res transformations, logging, monitoring
enforce rate limits, or apply security policies and guardrails
